implemented_requirements.requirement: Player controls snake using directional inputs
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._playing_keydown maps arrow/WASD keys to settings.DIR_* and queues them via snake.queue_direction
Game._tick calls snake.compute_next_head and snake.advance to move the snake each tick

implemented_requirements.requirement: Food items placed randomly on free cells
implemented_requirements.evidence: Food.randomize builds a list of free cells (excluding occupied_cells) and chooses one with random.choice

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake grows when it eats food
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._tick sets growing = (new_head == food.get_position()) and passes grow=growing to snake.advance; score is incremented
Game._tick checks snake.collides_with_point(new_head, ignore_tail=not growing) and calls _game_over on collision
Game._tick tests nx < 0 or nx >= GRID_WIDTH or ny < 0 or ny >= GRID_HEIGHT and triggers _game_over
Game._render redraws the board, snake, food and HUD every frame; update loop advances the snake each tick

implemented_requirements.requirement: Show current score based on food eaten

implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.DIFFICULTIES defines Easy/Medium/Hard; Game menu lets player select via up/down and starts with chosen difficulty affecting move speed

judge.summary: The provided source implements a fully functional classic Snake game: directional controls, random food, growth, collision detection, scoring, HUD, and a selectable difficulty menu. All core requirements are satisfied and the code appears ready to run with pygame installed.
